# iru_device_details (Data Source)

Read a device's full detail record (hardware, MDM, FileVault, security and more). Its shape varies by platform and enabled features, so it is returned as JSON; read fields with `jsondecode()`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iru_device_details" "loaner" {
  id = data.iru_device.loaner.id
}

locals {
  loaner_details = jsondecode(data.iru_device_details.loaner.json)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Device ID.

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) The detail record as JSON.
